doc_screened_files.reason: Direct panic site: the ICE names `FieldUniquenessCheckContext::check_field_in_nested_adt()` in this file, and the query stack reaches `collect_mod_item_types` while collecting `Foo`/`Bar` field types for the unnamed-field nest.

`collect.rs`’s nested-ADT field walk likely asks for field `type_of` results; this file supplies those collected item types, so a malformed `TyKind` flowing into field-uniqueness recursion would come through here.

This file validates ADT and union representation rules after type collection, including union-field and layout checks, so it is a likely secondary site for unnamed-field/nested-ADT invariants exposed by the repro.

The failing query stack is inside `predicates_of` for `Foo`; this file drives predicate collection over item types, so it is on the exact path that triggers `collect_mod_item_types` and the field-uniqueness walk.
Unnamed nested ADTs are lowered alongside item generics and parent/owner setup; this collector participates in building the metadata used when `collect.rs` walks nested anonymous structs/unions.

Field uniqueness and nested ADT checks ultimately depend on `AdtDef`/variant field modeling; if the ICE is an invariant mismatch on an unexpected field kind, this type-modeling layer is a plausible upstream contributor.

The repro stresses `#[repr(C)]` ADTs and unions with nested fields, which depend on layout computation; this file is the layout invariant checker that would surface bad ADT/field-shape assumptions downstream of collection.
The input uses the unstable `unnamed_fields` syntax, so AST validation is part of the front-end path that admits the constructs later handled by HIR collection and field-uniqueness logic.
`#![feature(unnamed_fields)]` is required for the reproducer, making feature-gating part of the gatekeeping path before the collected ADT fields reach HIR analysis.

This module coordinates the broader HIR checking phase that consumes the collected item types; it is less direct than `collect.rs`, but still a plausible integration point for an invariant leak from field collection into later checks.
